title.narrative: Emergency Assistance and Support to Evacuations

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe Emergency Assistance and Support to Evacuations project adopts a holistic approach to fill existing gaps in the evacuation from conflict zones along Ukraine's frontline areas to IDPs relocation. This project ensures that civilians from high-risk areas are safely transported to safe and inclusive locations enabling basic services and temporary accommodation. lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe project is built upon TERA Consortium of National NGOs led by a Team4UA with East SOS, Relief Coordination Center, Angels of Salvation and Posmishka UA as members. Local CSOs/NNGOs are integrated as Consortium partners with capacity development after selection endorsed by the Consortium members and the Protection Cluster. The most vulnerable beneficiaries in frontline areas in need of evacuations prioritized in the project are elderly persons, with disabilities or specific needs. The consortium provides a structured, scalable solution that aligns evacuation efforts with the realities of daily operations, ensuring more efficient and safe evacuations as summarized below: lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt1. Support for Local Partners:lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtAt least 10 CSOs/NNGOs will receive capacity development to safely conduct humanitarian evacuations or support in collective sites. This support includes financial assistance for operational costs to the CSOs/NNGOs selected with training and logistical support tailored to the needs of each local partner.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt2. Collaborative Consortium Operations:lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe project leverages a coordination platform between Consortium members to share operational planning and information, vehicles and premises. The platform also includes local partners with asset sharing related to the Duty of Care including life insurance for humanitarian workers and volunteers.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt3. Evacuation Process:lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt Identification and Outreach: RCC undertakes identification of vulnerable civilians in active conflict areas and coordinate evacuation efforts through their activities under HAVEN Consortium funding. A dedicated mobile team in transit centers and a hotline shall inform beneficiaries about the evacuation process and settling in Collective sites through a project-based booking system enhancing deduplication with external stakeholders and Governmental initiatives.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt Safe Transportation: Beneficiaries are transported by Angels of Salvation and local CSOs using secure routes and inclusively equipped vehicles to leave areas with intensive military activity. This includes coordinating with local authorities and humanitarian partners to ensure the safety of evacuees. lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt Collective Sites: Once evacuated, beneficiaries are temporarily housed in collective sites. East SOS enhances the collective sites capacity through reception improvements.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt4. Post-Evacuation Support:lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt Psychological and social services will be provided with case management for recent vulnerable IDPs as post-evacuation assistance. Posmishka UA shall improve Consortium coverage in western regions and Team4UA ensures continuity of assistance in Eastern Regions. lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt Accountability to Affected People mechanism is merged with a Consortium Referral System ensuring that individuals assisted can voice their concerns and receive tailored support. A hotline calls directly a representative sample of beneficiaries for AAP and monitoring while community outreach allows reception of beneficiaries’ request for post-evacuation support. Remote and field monitoring improve data collection on the full process of evacuations to be shared with the Protection Cluster and CCCM Cluster to improve future operations.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe project aims to establish multi-step evacuation system that delegates responsibilities across the Consortium members and partners. Each partner will have a specific role within the evacuation chain beneficiaries-centered for safe displacement from their homes to collective sites and hosting communities through transit centers.lt/pgtltpgtltspangtlt/spangtlt/pgt
